about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Response.about: VST3 parameter 2. Host display: 0 = Low Pass; 0 = Low Pass; 1 = High Pass; 1 = High Pass; 1 = High Pass.

parameters/Receive Midi.about: VST3 parameter 7. Host display: 0 = Enabled; 0 = Enabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled; 1 = Disabled.

parameters/Bypass.about: VST3 parameter 8. Host display: 0 = Not Bypassed; 0 = Not Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed; 1 = Bypassed.

Frequency [VST3 0].note: Public VST3 parameter 0 maps to component float slot 0; use stored values, not normalized automation or display text.
